== Skywalker Ranch card and citation fixes (21 October 2026) ==
* Per Bill (personal communication, 21 October 2026): a special promotional card made to show Lucasfilm, not a playtest card. Rewrote "As part of the pitch, Decipher showed Lucasfilm a mock-up Location card" to match. The card is no longer tied to the July 2000 presentation. Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 p. 3 shows the card without a caption, and the July 2000 excerpts do not mention it. This closes the Skywalker Ranch open question above, except that the date and place it was shown remain unsourced.
* Added Preserved copies (opened from the VPS): TFN 2001 (20261010072854), PC About Us (swccg.com snapshot, 20261020234816), Wikipedia (20261016121021).
* Virginian-Pilot 1994: scholar.lib.vt.edu now returns 410 Gone and Wayback has only redirect/410 captures, so the ref is now a print citation (newspaper, date, section) with no URL. The text was not re-checked against the article.
